Name: Dialogue Guard
Author: jkysa88
Description:
🧩 Overview
[b]Dialogue Guard[/b] is a lightweight utility mod that automatically detects and restores
missing or broken i18n dialogue lines by replacing them with the [b]original vanilla text[/b].
Once installed, it runs entirely on its own —
you don’t need to reload or constantly manage Content Patcher (CP) during testing.
It helps modders [b]write and test dialogue smoothly[/b] without breaking gameplay flow.
[b]It also includes a shuffle system that randomly selects from duplicate dialogue lines.

You can configure it within GMCM[/b][line]⚙️ Features[list]
[*]Detects and restores:
[list]
[*]Empty strings ([code]""[/code])
[*]Untranslated lines ([code](no translation:)[/code], [code]{{i18n:...}}[/code])
[/list][*]Automatically replaces invalid text with [b]vanilla dialogue[/b]
[*]Works with:
[list]
[*][code]Characters/Dialogue/*[/code]
[*][code]Characters/schedules/*[/code]
[*][code]Strings/*[/code]
[*]
[*][code]Data/Festivals/*[/code]
[/list][*]Fully automatic — [b]no setup required[/b]
[/list][line]💡 Why It’s Useful[list]
[*]No need to reload or manually manage CP while testing
[*]Keeps the game running even if i18n keys are missing or broken
[*]Lets players naturally experience dialogue while the modder reviews it in real time
[*][b]Upload once, update only when necessary[/b] — no ongoing maintenance required
[/list][line]🧠 How It Works
1️⃣ On startup, the mod takes a snapshot of vanilla dialogue data.
2️⃣ After other mods load, it checks for empty or broken entries.
3️⃣ Detected lines are automatically replaced with their vanilla counterparts.
4️⃣ Working lines remain untouched for full compatibility.
[line]✨ New Feature: Real-Time Overlay SystemThis version introduces the 'Fallback Overlay' system.
This feature displays real-time updates on screen when in-game dialogue data is replaced, restored, or shuffled.

Toggle display mode with the F8 key (Restored Dialogue / Shuffled Dialogue / Full View)

Hold down the Shift key to instantly display the overlay

Includes speaker name detection during conversations (enables filtering by current speaker's dialogue only)

The number of displayed items, preview options, and filtering methods can be configured in GMCM.

🧭 While primarily designed for debugging, this overlay is also highly beneficial for translation review and verifying shuffled dialogue.[quote][/quote]
[line]🪶 Summary[quote]💬 “Automatically restores broken or missing i18n dialogue to vanilla text.”
Keeps your game stable and lets modders focus on writing — not debugging.[/quote]
